_meta.purpose: AMF's real redevelopment phasing for Marievik, replacing guesswork with AMF Fastigheter's own schedule for the buildings it covers.
_meta.source: AMF Fastigheter, "Tidplan övergripande, Marievik" (Original 20-25-10-24, Rev 2026-09-11 av PK) — photographed by Sara and read by eye, 2026-10-27. Not a digital export.
_meta.building_mapping: AMF's own property codes vs. this model's building ids, confirmed by Sara 2026-10-27: M27 = B01, M19 = B02, M26 = B03. Flänshjulet 1 = M23 (not yet in marievik_site.json). M24 = Buteljgatan 29A, M25 = Årstaängsvägen 25, M28 = Marieviksgatan 19 — real AMF parcels, not yet matched to any B0x (B05/B06/B08 are on the same streets but identity unconfirmed). M14, M22, M23, M30 and the M15:Kv1-4 cluster are visible on AMF's 2019-04-26 site plan (M. Carlén) but also not yet in marievik_site.json.
_meta.confidence: Which building and which phase (vacate / construction / move-in) happens is reliable, read off clearly labelled rows. The exact quarter within a year is NOT reliable — the chart is a photographed, rotated, small-print Gantt with many overlapping bars; each event below is flagged with how sure the read is. Treat every date here as needing a second look against the original schedule, not as confirmed fact.

B01.note: This model's B01 currently shows full occupancy (data/projects/marievik/leases.json, fictional example tenants through 2027-2032). This real schedule shows M27 being vacated for redevelopment — the two are NOT yet reconciled; which one is right for 'today' depends on the exact vacate date, which is not confirmed here.

B02.note: Two sub-phases on the schedule, read as the H&M wing and the 'Kuber' wing. Which part of B02's floor plate each covers is not established.

B03.note: Row is explicitly marked '(preliminär)' on the source schedule — AMF itself flags this as not settled. A related 'Garagerenovering M26' (garage renovation) row exists but was not transcribed.
